title: Creamy Coconut Ice Pops
changes_from_base: A no-cook mix of cream, coconut milk, cream of coconut and shredded coconut replaces the strawberry purée.
summary: Rich, creamy coconut ice pops with shredded coconut suspended throughout.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk 415 ml double cream, 180 ml coconut milk, 180 ml cream of coconut, 25 g shredded coconut and a pinch of salt together in a jug.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Fill ten 80 ml moulds, whisking the mixture between each one so the coconut stays suspended rather than sinking.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Dip the moulds briefly in hot water to release the pops, taking care not to let them melt.

tips: Whisk the mixture between filling each mould so the shredded coconut doesn't all settle in the first few.
Add the sticks only after the initial 1 h chill, once the mixture has thickened enough to hold them upright.
Dip the moulds briefly rather than holding them under water, as this mixture softens quickly.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
